caption: The drawing features two adjacent, mirror-image, leaf-shaped objects positioned near the center of a beige or off-white background. Each object is outlined with ornate, intricate dot-and-dash detailing and filled with a light gold or yellow color. At the center, where the two shapes meet, is a cluster of seven small, round blue elements, likely representing stones or beads, arranged in a floral pattern. Below this colored illustration, there is a faint pencil sketch that repeats the shapes and layout of the colored design, illustrating the object from a top-down perspective with indications of fitting or locking mechanisms. The rest of the page is blank except for some slight yellowing and a few small stains, with handwritten notations in orange ink along the bottom right edge.
title: Jewelry
